title: `AppendCheckpointTrailer` can emit a trailer the final-block parser (and git) reject

worker.report:
I added a regression test and fixed the writer. The narrow test passes now, but I didn't run it against the old code first, so I haven't seen it fail.

The fix is in `appendTrailerLine`. It now classifies the final paragraph from raw lines, with the same grammar as git:
- The first line must be a real trailer.
- Every later line must be a trailer or an indented continuation.
- A blank line must separate the paragraph from the content above.

An indented `Entire-Checkpoint:` paragraph therefore no longer counts as a trailer block, and the new trailer starts its own paragraph. A trailer block that ends in an indented continuation line is now recognised, so no blank line is inserted into it. I did not extract a shared `isTrailerBlock` helper or change `finalTrailerBlock`, to keep the change small.

I ran `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/trailers/ -run 'TestAppendCheckpointTrailer'` and it passes. That run also covers the existing `TestAppendCheckpointTrailer` cases, so the trailer-shaped-subject guard is checked. The new test has three cases: space-indented, tab-indented, and a trailer followed by a continuation line.

Test added: `TestAppendCheckpointTrailer_IndentedFinalParagraph`
Files changed: `cmd/entire/cli/trailers/trailers.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/trailers/append_indented_test.go` (new)
